entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6283723285046532864: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.1912 +/- 0.0262 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 192.64 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 0.088, 17.350 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.14 +/- 0.09 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-16 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). Mass 1.78 +/- 0.54 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-16 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). Temperature 5700 +/- 150 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-16 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,700 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff0e7. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,700 K and log g 4.57 (u1 0.476, u2 0.249): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
